interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian-actuated signals to provide safe crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Resurface the existing walkway to remove trip hazards and widen it to at least 6 feet to improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk across the driveway at grade and with consistent materials to signal pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Apply clear pavement markings to define a dedicated pedestrian path through the parking area.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crossing utilizing the existing median as a refuge island, potentially with a HAWK signal.
